title: Radon Level Weekend vs Weekday Occupancy
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=radon:reading
| search radon_bq_m3=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(radon_bq_m3) as avg_radon_bq_m3 max(radon_bq_m3) as max_radon_bq_m3 by _time day_type
| sort - _time
description: Tracks radon levels by occupancy type over time and breaks it out by day type.
value: Weekend versus weekday splits help reveal whether occupancy and ventilation habits are moving the radon baseline.
implementation: Send radon levels by occupancy type events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of radon levels by occupancy type by day type.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how radon levels by occupancy type changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
